contributionMap.claim: For every footrule in (-1/2, 0), the least population Chatterjee coefficient is attained by exactly one copula C_k (threshold solving a linear integral equation with a triangular kernel), with a dual certificate over all copulas and a quadratic stability estimate; this completes the exact (xi, psi) region
